model.title: A resolution relating to the death of the Honorable Nancy Kassebaum, former United States Senator for the State of Kansas.

summary.text: The resolution expresses the Senate's deep sorrow and regret at the death of Nancy Kassebaum, a former United States Senator from Kansas, asks the Secretary of the Senate to share the resolution with the House of Representatives and send an official copy to her family, and adjourns the Senate for the day as a mark of respect to her memory.
